gap.title: West Bengal gap by year
gap.description: Undergraduate pass-outs (AISHE Table 33) and EPFO net new payroll aged 18-25 for West Bengal, 2019-20 to 2023-24; built from the state-jobs-gap repository (data/wb_gap.csv).

peers.title: Peer states ratio
peers.description: EPFO net new payroll aged 18-25 per undergraduate pass-out for West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Karnataka and Maharashtra (data/peer_ratio.csv).

education.title: Unemployment by education
education.description: PLFS 2025 annual report Tables 22-24: LFPR, WPR and UR by highest education level, West Bengal and all India, usual status, age 15+, persons.

districts.title: West Bengal districts
districts.description: PLFS 2025 district snapshot: state and ten most populous districts; LFPR, WPR, UR for age 15+ and NEET for 15-29.

kolkata.title: Kolkata and Howrah benchmarks
kolkata.description: PLFS 2025 Million-plus Cities report: Kolkata and Howrah city corporations against all million-plus cities and urban India. Copied by hand from the report tables.

sens.title: Sensitivity of the ratio
sens.description: Scenarios that change the assumptions behind the headline ratio of EPFO net payroll to undergraduate pass-outs, West Bengal 2019-20 to 2023-24 (data/pressure_test_sensitivity.csv).

youth.title: Peers per young person
youth.description: Undergraduate pass-outs and EPFO net payroll aged 18-25 per 100 people aged 18-23 (AISHE Table 38) for West Bengal and four peer states (data/pressure_test_peers_per_youth.csv).

adjacent.title: Neighbouring states
adjacent.description: West Bengal and the states bordering it (Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, Assam, Sikkim): formal entry per pass-out under four scenarios, per 100 young people, graduate unemployment and participation, NEET (data/adjacent_states_summary.csv). Sikkim has no EPFO state figures.

south.title: Large states
south.description: West Bengal with Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Kerala, Karnataka and Maharashtra: formal entry per pass-out under four scenarios, per 100 young people, graduate unemployment and participation, NEET (data/large_states_summary.csv).

robust.title: Robustness check
robust.description: Eleven states with EPFO formal entrants per 100 young people and PLFS 2025 residence-based measures: regular wage or salaried share, limited-company share of non-farm workers, regular jobs without social security, and a rough formal-job density (data/robustness_plfs.csv).
